text: Welcome to Real Easy English, our easy podcast
zh: 欢迎收听 Real Easy English，我们的轻松播客
zh_hant: 歡迎收聽 Real Easy English，我們的輕鬆播客

text: where we have real conversations in easy English.
zh: 在这里我们用简单的英语进行真实的对话。
zh_hant: 在這裡我們用簡單的英語進行真實的對話。

text: I'm Neil.
And I'm Beth.
You can watch a video version of this podcast over on our website
zh: 你可以在我们网站上观看这期播客的视频版
zh_hant: 你可以在我們網站上觀看這期播客的影片版

text: and you'll find a free worksheet there as well.
zh: 那里还有一份免费的学习工作表。
zh_hant: 那裡還有一份免費的學習工作表。

text: Go to bbclearningenglish.com.
Beth, how are you?
I'm good, thank you.
Although I was late to work this morning.
zh: 不过我今早上班迟到了。
zh_hant: 不過我今早上班遲到了。

text: Oh no.
The traffic was bad.
Ah.
We're talking about driving today.
We are.
And sometimes I drive to work and I did today,
zh: 有时候我开车上班，今天也是，
zh_hant: 有時候我開車上班，今天也是，

text: but I should have got the train because, yeah, like I say, the traffic was bad.
zh: 但我本应该坐火车的，因为，对，就像我说的，交通很糟糕。
zh_hant: 但我本應該坐火車的，因為，對，就像我說的，交通很糟糕。

text: So clearly you can drive.
Do you like driving?
Thing?
It depends.
If I am commuting,
so coming to work by car, I don't enjoy it,
zh: 也就是开车来上班，我不享受，
zh_hant: 也就是開車來上班，我不享受，

text: Usually, because of the traffic.
zh: 通常是这样，因为交通的关系。
zh_hant: 通常是這樣，因為交通的關係。

text: But if I have a long journey,
like if I go to see a friend and I'm in the car for three hours,
zh: 比如我去看朋友，要在车里待三个小时，
zh_hant: 比如我去看朋友，要在車裡待三個小時，

text: I actually really enjoy it because I listen to music,
zh: 我其实很享受，因为我听音乐、
zh_hant: 我其實很享受，因為我聽音樂、

text: podcasts, maybe an audio book,
and I can relax and just drive along the motorway,
zh: 我可以放松，就沿着高速公路开，
zh_hant: 我可以放鬆，就沿著高速公路開，

text: listening to something I like.
What about you?
You drive, don't you?
I drive, yeah, not that often because I live in London
zh: 我开车，对，但不常开，因为我住在伦敦
zh_hant: 我開車，對，但不常開，因為我住在倫敦

text: and I can use public transport.
That's one of the benefits of living in London, definitely.
zh: 这绝对是住在伦敦的好处之一。
zh_hant: 這絕對是住在倫敦的好處之一。

text: Do you enjoy driving?
It's okay.
It's not a big love of mine,
but like you said,
sometimes it's quite nice if you're somewhere,
zh: 有时候还挺不错的，如果你在某个地方，
zh_hant: 有時候還挺不錯的，如果你在某個地方，

text: maybe in the countryside on your own,
you can listen to loud music and, yeah, singing in the car
zh: 你可以大声放音乐，而且，对，在车里唱歌
zh_hant: 你可以大聲放音樂，而且，對，在車裡唱歌

text: is good fun.
Are you good at driving, or do you think people would say you're good at driving?
zh: 你开车开得好吗，还是你觉得别人会说 you 开车开得好？
zh_hant: 你開車開得好嗎，還是你覺得別人會說 you 開車開得好？

text: I don't know.
I think I'm okay.
I've never had an accident, touch wood.
zh: 我从没出过事故，敲敲木头。
zh_hant: 我從沒出過事故，敲敲木頭。

text: Oh, that's good.
I haven't had an accident,
but I did get caught speeding
zh: 但我确实被抓到超速过一次
zh_hant: 但我確實被抓到超速過一次

text: once and that means I was going too fast,
zh: 那意味着我开得太快了，
zh_hant: 那意味著我開得太快了，

text: and I had to go on a speed awareness course,
zh: 我不得不去上超速意识课程，
zh_hant: 我不得不去上超速意識課程，

text: and I haven't sped since.
zh: 从那以后我就没超速过。
zh_hant: 從那以後我就沒超速過。

text: Speeding, Beth?
That's dangerous.
I was going a few miles an hour over the speed limit.
zh: 我当时只是比限速快了几英里每小时。
zh_hant: 我當時只是比限速快了幾英里每小時。

text: So is there anything that you don't like about driving, Neil?
zh: 那开车有什么你不喜欢的吗，Neil？
zh_hant: 那開車有什麼你不喜歡的嗎，Neil？

text: Yeah, I don't really like parking
because in a busy city especially,
zh: 因为尤其是在繁忙的城市里，
zh_hant: 因為尤其是在繁忙的城市裡，

text: it can be difficult to find somewhere to park.
And also, when you do find somewhere to park,
zh: 而且，就算你找到了停车的地方，
zh_hant: 而且，就算你找到了停車的地方，

text: the space can be really small, and then you have to try to get your car into this little space.
zh: 车位可能很小，然后你得试着把车停进这个小空间里。
zh_hant: 車位可能很小，然後你得試著把車停進這個小空間裡。

text: Often with other people waiting for you to do it.
zh: 经常还有别人等着你做这件事。
zh_hant: 經常還有別人等著你做這件事。

text: Yeah, I don't like doing that.
When you're on a road and there's cars behind you,
zh: 当你在路上，后面有车的时候，
zh_hant: 當你在路上，後面有車的時候，

text: outside of my house we have to reverse into a parking space.
zh: 我家外面得倒车进停车位。
zh_hant: 我家外面得倒車進停車位。

text: So reversing, going backwards
for parking, I'm OK with now.
zh: 来停车，我现在没问题了。
zh_hant: 來停車，我現在沒問題了。

text: I didn't used to like it,
but now it's fine because I have to do it whenever I drive.
zh: 但现在没问题了，因为我每次开车都得这么做。
zh_hant: 但現在沒問題了，因為我每次開車都得這麼做。

text: Beth, did you find it difficult or easy to learn how to drive?
zh: Beth，你觉得学开车难还是容易？
zh_hant: Beth，你覺得學開車難還是容易？

text: Hmm, good question.
I found it not easy, not difficult.
zh: 我觉得不算容易，也不算难。
zh_hant: 我覺得不算容易，也不算難。

text: I remember thinking, everyone I know can drive,
zh: 我记得我想，我认识的每个人都会开车，
zh_hant: 我記得我想，我認識的每個人都會開車，

text: so I know that I'm also going to be able to drive, and that helped me.
zh: 所以我知道我也一定能学会开车，这对我有帮助。
zh_hant: 所以我知道我也一定能學會開車，這對我有幫助。

text: But the driving on a road was fine,
and even changing gears, that kind of thing was okay.
zh: 甚至换挡，那种事情也行。
zh_hant: 甚至換擋，那種事情也行。

text: But I found parking when I was learning how to park,
zh: 但我觉得停车，在我学怎么停车的时候，
zh_hant: 但我覺得停車，在我學怎麼停車的時候，

text: and we have to, or we had to reverse around a corner.
zh: 而且我们得，或者说我们当时得绕着一个角倒车。
zh_hant: 而且我們得，或者說我們當時得繞著一個角倒車。

text: Those kind of manoeuvres they call them,
I found difficult.
But I did pass my test first time.
zh: 不过我第一次就通过了考试。
zh_hant: 不過我第一次就透過了考試。

text: What about you?
Did you find it easy to learn to drive?
I think it was quite easy.
I passed first time, like you did.
zh: 我跟你一样，第一次就过了。
zh_hant: 我跟你一樣，第一次就過了。

text: But I remember the man who took the test
was very critical of me at the end
and even angry.
And I was scared.
I thought, I must have failed the test.
zh: 我想，我肯定没通过考试。
zh_hant: 我想，我肯定沒透過考試。

text: And then he said, congratulations, You passed.
zh: 然后他说，恭喜，你通过了。
zh_hant: 然後他說，恭喜，你透過了。

text: I think he just wanted to let me know that driving
zh: 我觉得他只是想让我知道，开车
zh_hant: 我覺得他只是想讓我知道，開車

text: is dangerous and you shouldn't just relax now because you've passed and that you will continue to learn
zh: 这很危险，你不能因为通过了就放松下来，还要继续学习。
zh_hant: 這很危險，你不能因為透過了就放鬆下來，還要繼續學習。

text: after your test.
Definitely.
Let's recap the vocabulary we've learned in this podcast,
zh: 让我们回顾一下这期播客学到的词汇，
zh_hant: 讓我們回顧一下這期播客學到的詞彙，

text: starting with to commute, which means to travel to work,
zh: 从 to commute 开始，意思是去上班，
zh_hant: 從 to commute 開始，意思是去上班，

text: either in a car, a train, a bus, some form of transport.
zh: 坐汽车、火车、公交车，某种交通方式。
zh_hant: 坐汽車、火車、公交車，某種交通方式。

text: We also had speeding.
If you speed,
you're going faster than you are allowed to, faster than the speed limit.
zh: 你开得比允许的速度快，比限速快。
zh_hant: 你開得比允許的速度快，比限速快。

text: We heard to park,
which means to move your car
into a space where you can leave it for a while.
zh: 移到某个可以停放一段时间的地方。
zh_hant: 移到某個可以停放一段時間的地方。

text: And the noun of that is parking.
When you reverse a car, you drive it backwards.
zh: 当你 reverse 一辆车，就是往后开。
zh_hant: 當你 reverse 一輛車，就是往後開。

text: And when you are parking, you often need to reverse.
zh: 停车的时候，你经常需要倒车。
zh_hant: 停車的時候，你經常需要倒車。

text: That's it for this episode of Real Easy English.
zh: 这就是这期 Real Easy English 的全部内容。
zh_hant: 這就是這期 Real Easy English 的全部內容。

text: Why not test what you've learned with the free worksheet on our website, bbclearningenglish.com.
zh: 何不用我们网站 bbclearningenglish.com 上的免费学习表测试一下你学到的内容。
zh_hant: 何不用我們網站 bbclearningenglish.com 上的免費學習表測試一下你學到的內容。

text: And we'll be back next week with another conversation in Easy English.
zh: 下周我们会带着另一段轻松英语对话回来。
zh_hant: 下週我們會帶著另一段輕鬆英語對話回來。

text: See you soon!
Goodbye.
